With the in-depth advancement of the national fitness strategy, the demand for scientific sports training continues to grow. However, existing intelligent training systems generally face three major deficiencies: the training guidance lacks the support of authoritative knowledge and is prone to providing unsubstantiated suggestions; the systems cannot retain user states across sessions, making it difficult to achieve real personalized management; a single model is difficult to concurrently take on multiple professional roles such as training planning, technical guidance, and sports rehabilitation. To address the above problems, this paper designs and implements an intelligent sports training system with memory capability based on multi-agent and retrieval-augmented generation
In terms of the technical scheme, this paper carries out targeted optimization around three types of mismatch phenomena in the sports training scenario:

To solve the problems of misalignment between users' colloquial questions and professional literature expressions, insufficient coverage of a single retrieval, and answers prone to being divorced from evidence, a retrieval-augmented generation for sports training combined with multi-query expansion and hypothetical document embedding is designed, and citation constraints and post-validation are added on the generation side;

To address the problem that the system cannot continuously utilize users' long-term states, a three-layer memory system consisting of working memory, episodic memory, and semantic memory is designed, enabling training goals, injury restrictions, historical load, and preferences to be precipitated across sessions and reversely constrain retrieval and generation;

To solve the problem that a single model is difficult to simultaneously take into account training planning, technical guidance, and rehabilitation evaluation, a multi-agent collaboration process based on LangGraph is designed. These three respectively correspond to the three core problems of "knowledge mismatch", "state mismatch", and "role mismatch", and together form the technical closed-loop of the system.

The system adopts a front-end and back-end separation architecture. The back-end is built based on FastAPI and LangGraph, and the front-end adopts the Vue3 framework, supporting multi-format document processing and multi-modal image-text unified retrieval. Experimental results show that the retrieval-augmented generation for sports training proposed in this paper achieves 0.84 in Precision@5, 0.79 in Recall@5, 0.88 in Faithfulness, and 0.91 in Relevancy on 300 sports training test samples; the three-layer long-term memory achieves a personalized

matching accuracy of 0.87; the multi-agent collaboration mechanism achieves a task completion rate of 0.93 in complex training support tasks. The above results indicate that the scheme proposed in this paper has good effectiveness in three dimensions: knowledge reliability, personalized adaptation, and complex task collaboration.

系统性能与可扩展性优化。当前系统采用单机部署，在高并发场景下可能存在性能瓶颈。未来可考虑引入分布式架构，将向量数据库替换为支持横向扩展的
等方案，并优化智能体调度机制，提升系统的并发处理能力与服务稳定性。
可解释性与安全性提升。运动训练建议直接影响用户健康，系统需进一步强化建议的可解释性，为每项训练推荐提供明确的科学依据引用。同时，应建立更完善的内容安全过滤机制，防止系统输出潜在有害的训练建议，保障用户安全。
